view.sentenceEn: This was after his online interview attracted millions of views and was made into a song.
view.translationZh: 此前，他的在线采访吸引了数百万次观看，并被改编成了一首歌。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

view.sentenceEn: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
view.translationZh: 一项调查显示，尽管有报道称许多美国人认为志愿服务很有价值，但只有26%的美国人参与了志愿服务。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

view.sentenceEn: "In view of the climate crisis, I didn't want to open the same restaurant," Humm told the Financial Times in an interview.
view.translationZh: “鉴于气候危机，我不想再开一家同样的餐厅，”胡姆在接受《金融时报》采访时表示。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

view.sentenceEn: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action.
view.translationZh: 说服的艺术是指促使他人认同你的观点或跟随你的行动方案。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

view.sentenceEn: In more conventional views , gaming is a time-wasting activity pursued by young boys.
view.translationZh: 在更为传统的观念中，玩游戏被视为一种由年轻男孩参与的浪费时间的活动。

view.sentenceEn: They hold different views about postponing retirement.
view.translationZh: 他们对延迟退休持不同看法。

various.sentenceEn: Researchers have suggested that such links could arise from various things.
various.translationZh: 研究人员认为，这种关联可能源于多种因素。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

various.sentenceEn: Yet whereas most countries have detailed, evidence-backed guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise required for various physical health benefits, such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood.
various.translationZh: 然而，尽管大多数国家都有详细的、有证据支持的指南，规定了获得各种身体健康益处所需的运动类型和强度，但针对运动与情绪的此类指南尚未问世。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

various.sentenceEn: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits(特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other.
various.translationZh: 为了解释这种看似非理性的行为，赫什菲尔德及其团队扫描了研究参与者的大脑，同时询问他们各种特征（如“正直”或“风趣”）在多大程度上适用于当前的自己、未来的自己、当前的他人或未来的他人。

various.sentenceEn: Today, researchers are likely to be funded by a mix of grants from various government agencies, institutions, and foundations.
various.translationZh: 如今，研究人员的资金来源可能是各种政府机构、科研院所和基金会的混合资助。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

various.sentenceEn: What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for strengthening relationships?
various.translationZh: 马图什如何看待那些从其他领域借鉴来的用于加强人际关系的各种心理学方法？

various.sentenceEn: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
various.translationZh: 它能降低因肉类消费带来的各种健康风险。

variety.sentenceEn: While we know that adults use a large variety of attributes to manage and create impressions, we don't yet know whether children understand and use the fact that different attributes are valuable at different times to different audiences.
variety.translationZh: 虽然我们知道成年人会使用各种各样的特质来管理和营造印象，但我们尚不清楚儿童是否理解并运用这一事实——即不同的特质在不同时间对不同受众具有不同的价值。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

variety.sentenceEn: Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat.
variety.translationZh: 较新的品种模仿肉类的外观、风味和质地。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

variety.sentenceEn: He eats a variety of different vegetables and nuts, especially those with high amounts of protein.
variety.translationZh: 他食用各种不同的蔬菜和坚果，尤其是那些蛋白质含量高的食物。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

variety.sentenceEn: They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and jumping.
variety.translationZh: 他们将有多种项目可供选择，包括径赛、投掷和跳跃。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

variety.sentenceEn: What did the researchers want to determine by testing a variety of possible explanations?
variety.translationZh: 研究人员通过测试各种可能的解释想要确定什么？

variety.sentenceEn: A display of a variety of products increases consumers' interest.
variety.translationZh: 展示多种产品能提高消费者的兴趣。

vehicle.sentenceEn: Investigators reviewed videos of the collection boxes; the video showed the two men loading the stolen mail into Jax's vehicle .
vehicle.translationZh: 调查人员查看了收集箱的监控录像；视频显示两名男子正将被盗邮件装载到Jax的车上。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vehicle.sentenceEn: Increasing the spacing of vehicles dampens the effect of slowdowns by cars in front of a given car, so that the slowing is not worsened until it becomes a phantom jam, the researchers said.
vehicle.translationZh: 研究人员表示，增加车辆之间的间距可以减轻前方车辆减速对当前车辆的影响，从而延缓减速加剧直至形成幽灵堵车的过程。

vehicle.sentenceEn: The bilateral control approach would include adding rear-facing sensors to determine the distance to the vehicle following a car.
vehicle.translationZh: 双边控制方法将包括添加后视传感器，以确定与跟随车辆的距离。

vehicle.sentenceEn: A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly, which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave, getting worse the farther it spreads.
vehicle.translationZh: 幽灵堵车始于拥堵车流中的一辆车轻微减速，这导致其后方车辆减速更甚——这种减速行为像波浪一样在车道中向后传播，传播得越远，拥堵就越严重。

vehicle.sentenceEn: Horn said with some simple modifications to the existing equipment in new vehicles , their spacing bilateral control could be accomplished.
vehicle.translationZh: 霍恩表示，只需对新车中的现有设备进行一些简单改装，就能实现它们的间距双向控制。

vehicle.sentenceEn: Driverless vehicles are likely to be misused by some people.
vehicle.translationZh: 无人驾驶车辆可能会被一些人滥用。

vary.sentenceEn: They will vary their behaviour in order to appear moral or socially good in the eyes of key observers.
vary.translationZh: 他们会改变自己的行为，以便在关键观察者眼中显得有道德或品行良好。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vary.sentenceEn: The overall trend is hitting Americans of all different levels of educational attainment, although the percentages vary by category.
vary.translationZh: 这一总体趋势影响着不同受教育程度的美国人，尽管各类的百分比有所不同。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

vary.sentenceEn: These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate, and disease exposure varying across the course of the year.
vary.translationZh: 这些因素包括全年变化的营养摄入、日照时间、气候条件和疾病接触情况。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

vary.sentenceEn: In fact, Americans currently consume almost twice the National Academy of Medicine's recommended daily intake of protein although the most desirable protein intake may vary depending on age and activity level.
vary.translationZh: 事实上，美国人目前的蛋白质摄入量几乎是美国国家医学院建议每日摄入量的两倍，尽管最理想的蛋白质摄入量可能因年龄和活动水平而异。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

vary.sentenceEn: Opinions vary , particularly because viewing habits among consumers continue to evolve.
vary.translationZh: 对此人们看法不一，尤其是因为消费者的观看习惯在不断变化。

vary.sentenceEn: They vary in different stages of brain development.
vary.translationZh: 它们在脑发育的不同阶段有所不同。

valuable.sentenceEn: While we know that adults use a large variety of attributes to manage and create impressions, we don't yet know whether children understand and use the fact that different attributes are valuable at different times to different audiences.
valuable.translationZh: 虽然我们知道成年人会使用各种各样的特质来管理和营造印象，但我们尚不清楚儿童是否理解并运用这一事实——即不同的特质在不同时间对不同受众具有不同的价值。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

valuable.sentenceEn: Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre.
valuable.translationZh: 含蔬菜的果汁比纯水果制成的果汁能提供更多营养和更少糖分——但它们仍然缺乏宝贵的膳食纤维。

valuable.sentenceEn: Game Academy's idea is simple: analyse gamers' habits from their online gaming profile, and offer courses in valuable skills that reflect their aptitudes — skills they can practise and refine in-game.
valuable.translationZh: Game Academy 的核心理念非常简单：通过分析玩家的在线游戏资料来评估其行为习惯，并提供与其天赋相匹配的有价值技能课程，让玩家在游戏过程中实践并精进这些技能。

valuable.sentenceEn: Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.
valuable.translationZh: 让习惯与有价值的结果相关联，将帮助你永久坚持这个习惯。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

valuable.sentenceEn: Learning by itself can be valuable for you, but if you want to be valuable to others, then you have to express your knowledge in some way.
valuable.translationZh: 学习本身对你可能很有价值，但如果你想对他人有价值，就必须以某种方式表达你的知识。

valuable.sentenceEn: They provide valuable resources for scientific research.
valuable.translationZh: 它们为科学研究提供了宝贵的资源。

vision.sentenceEn: This study gathered that students had a clearer vision of the blackboard and were able to focus more attention on the instructor.
vision.translationZh: 研究表明，学生看黑板的视野更清晰，且能将注意力更多地集中在教师身上。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

vision.sentenceEn: We are also grateful to our guests and partners who believed in our vision and encouraged us to push harder.
vision.translationZh: 我们也衷心感谢各位合作伙伴与客户，感谢你们相信我们的愿景，并激励我们不断进取。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

vision.sentenceEn: Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining'.
vision.translationZh: 现在，这一令人瞩目的新成就肯定了 Eleven Madison Park 餐厅将肉类移出菜单并拥抱植物性饮食的决定，米其林 2022 纽约指南也将其誉为‘对奢华餐饮的大胆愿景’。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

vision.sentenceEn: In Keynes's vision , the resulting unemployment would be distributed more or less evenly across society in the form of increased leisure.
vision.translationZh: 在凯恩斯的构想中，由此产生的失业问题将以增加闲暇时间的形式或多或少均匀地分布于整个社会。

vision.sentenceEn: While those visions of our future selves can be inspiring, when it comes to actually doing the day-to-day work, it may be more effective to reframe activities in terms of their immediate, or at least very near-term, rewards.
vision.translationZh: 虽然对未来自我的憧憬能给人启发，但在实际进行日常工作时，将活动重新定义为能带来即时或至少近期回报的事情，可能会更有效。

vision.sentenceEn: They actually wanted a clear vision of the blackboard.
vision.translationZh: 他们其实是想看清黑板。

vulnerable.sentenceEn: The most recent count of pandas found that there were more than 1,800 left in the wild, putting them on the list of vulnerable , but not endangered, species.
vulnerable.translationZh: 最新的大熊猫数量统计显示，野外生存的大熊猫超过1800只，这使它们被列为易危物种，但尚未达到濒危级别。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: The article also explained how advertising campaigns specifically target very young and poor people, causing harm for these vulnerable groups.
vulnerable.translationZh: 文章还解释了广告活动是如何专门针对青少年和贫困群体的，而这正在对这些弱势群体造成伤害。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: While this can be good news for the world's poorest people who now consume more calories, protein and fat than in the past, homogeneity(同一性) and over-dependence on a handful of staples leave us vulnerable to threats such as drought, disease and pests—all of which are predicted to worsen in many parts of the world as a result of climate change.
vulnerable.translationZh: 虽然这对世界上最贫困的人群来说可能是个好消息——他们现在摄入的热量、蛋白质和脂肪比过去都有所增加，但饮食的同一性以及对少数几种主食的过度依赖，使我们容易受到干旱、疾病和虫害等威胁的影响。而气候变化预计将导致这些威胁在世界许多地区进一步加剧。

vulnerable.sentenceEn: She also faces investigation from childcare services, who will also be asking why Karla was left alone with her vulnerable relatives.
vulnerable.translationZh: 她还面临着儿童福利机构的调查，该机构也将询问为何卡拉会被单独留给年迈体弱的亲属照顾。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: What is more important to an emotionally vulnerable person?
vulnerable.translationZh: 对于情感脆弱的人来说，什么更为重要？

vulnerable.sentenceEn: It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable .
vulnerable.translationZh: 让数百万人处于贫困和脆弱状态是危险的。

vote.sentenceEn: The citizens of this county voted in November 2016 and again in March 2017 to raise their own taxes.
vote.translationZh: 该县市民于2016年11月及2017年3月两次投票支持提高自己的税负。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

vote.sentenceEn: The university administration will likely vote to raise costs at least once more before my graduation.
vote.translationZh: 在我毕业前，大学管理层很可能还会至少再投票决定一次涨价。

vote.sentenceEn: So when my university voted to raise tuition costs 3% at the end of my freshman year, my financial aid package remained the same and I was suddenly responsible for an additional $1,200 for the next year.
vote.translationZh: 因此，当我所在的大学在我大一结束时投票决定将学费提高3%，而我的助学金数额保持不变，这意味着我突然要为下一学年额外承担1200美元的费用。

vote.sentenceEn: The village of Maref in Alaska voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland.
vote.translationZh: 阿拉斯加的马雷夫村周二投票决定搬迁至该州大陆。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

vote.sentenceEn: Why did the citizens of Los Angeles vote to raise their own taxes?
vote.translationZh: 为什么洛杉矶市民投票决定提高自己的税收？

vote.sentenceEn: Any candidate who wins the most of the vote could be the winner.
vote.translationZh: 任何获得最多选票的候选人都可能成为赢家。

vast.sentenceEn: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tonnes of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets.
vast.translationZh: 英国零售业每年20万吨的食品浪费中，绝大多数来自超市。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

vast.sentenceEn: Honestly, I hear the same answer from the vast majority of people I meet.
vast.translationZh: 说实话，我从遇到的绝大多数人那里听到的都是同样的答案。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

vast.sentenceEn: A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around.
vast.translationZh: 绝大多数人更喜欢协作与团队合作，而非传统的组织结构；没人喜欢被指手画脚或受人摆布。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

vast.sentenceEn: Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.
vast.translationZh: 对于任何太空任务而言，发射通常是对环境危害最大的阶段，大量燃料在短短几分钟内燃烧殆尽。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

vast.sentenceEn: The vast majority of men, 97%, said one of the top reasons to take leave was to share caregiving with their partner.
vast.translationZh: 绝大多数男性（97%）表示，休假的首要原因之一是与伴侣共同承担育儿责任。

vast.sentenceEn: Draw on a vast wealth of past experience.

villa.sentenceEn: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as "Spanish seaside villas ".
villa.translationZh: 诈骗者还投资于付费点击广告，以便在人们输入诸如“西班牙海滨别墅”等搜索词时，能出现在搜索引擎结果的顶部。

villa.sentenceEn: Details of legitimate(合法的) villas are often stolen from other sites.
villa.translationZh: 合法别墅的详细信息常常是从其他网站盗取的。

villa.sentenceEn: "When people book their holidays they get so emotionally involved, and when they find that villa at a good price with availability in peak season, they are an easy target," says Cooper.
villa.translationZh: 库珀说：“人们预订假期时往往情感投入很深，当他们发现一栋价格优惠且在旺季有空房的别墅时，就很容易成为诈骗目标。”

villa.sentenceEn: Although she found another villa in time for their holiday, she admits she was much more cautious.
villa.translationZh: 虽然她及时找到了另一栋别墅供度假使用，但她承认自己变得谨慎多了。

villa.sentenceEn: Fraudsters advertise their villas at reasonable prices so as not to be suspected.
villa.translationZh: 诈骗者以合理价格为其别墅做广告，以免引起怀疑。

villa.sentenceEn: Fake holiday villa websites prompt warning
villa.translationZh: 虚假度假别墅网站引发警示

vital.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.
vital.translationZh: 研究得出结论，若大熊猫觉得栖息地过于舒适，它们便不会离开去寻找新的配偶，从而导致关键遗传多样性的缺乏。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vital.sentenceEn: Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and organizations that want to push forward and do more.
vital.translationZh: 富有成效的冲突是那些想要不断前进、成就更多的团队和组织的重要组成部分。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

vital.sentenceEn: This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur.
vital.translationZh: 这是个问题，因为它会阻碍你适应新环境的能力，而这种能力对于想要成为成功企业家的人来说至关重要。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vital.sentenceEn: Yet knowing when it's going to rain is vital for farmers wanting to sow seeds, irrigate crops or take their animals out to the fields to feed on grass.
vital.translationZh: 然而，对于农民而言，了解何时会下雨至关重要——他们需要根据雨情来播种、灌溉庄稼，或是赶牲畜到田里吃草。

vital.sentenceEn: What is vital according to the chief executive of National Numeracy?
vital.translationZh: 根据英国国家数学能力中心首席执行官的说法，什么是至关重要的？

vital.sentenceEn: They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions.
vital.translationZh: 它们对于在商业交易中保持主导地位至关重要。

valley.sentenceEn: No one is spared his sharp analysis: not the easy targets of 19th century women's crippling(伤害身体的) fashions nor the modern uniforms of Silicon Valley T-shirts
valley.translationZh: 没有人能逃过他犀利的分析：无论是19世纪束缚女性身体的时尚这类容易抨击的目标，还是硅谷T恤衫这种现代制服，无一幸免。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

valley.sentenceEn: As Silicon Valley has become home to more successful companies, the flood of people to the area has caused housing prices to skyrocket.
valley.translationZh: 随着硅谷涌现出越来越多成功企业，大量人口涌入该地区导致房价飙升。

valley.sentenceEn: "I think there is a broad consciousness in the Valley that we can do better than to leave thousands of our neighbors behind through a period of extraordinary success," San Jose Mayor Sam Liccardo said.
valley.translationZh: 圣何塞市市长山姆·李卡多表示：“我认为硅谷有一个普遍共识——在这个取得非凡成就的时期，我们可以做得更好，而不是把成千上万的邻里同胞抛在身后。”

valley.sentenceEn: With Silicon Valley in its backyard, it certainly has the chance to do so.
valley.translationZh: 硅谷就在自家后院，圣何塞自然有机会重拾这一地位。

valley.sentenceEn: In contrast, California, home of Silicon Valley , recently proposed far more restrictive rules that would require human drivers to be ready to take the wheel, and ban commercial use of self-driving technology.
valley.translationZh: 相比之下，作为硅谷所在地的加利福尼亚州最近却提出了限制性强得多的规定，要求必须有人类驾驶员随时准备接管车辆，并禁止自动驾驶技术的商业使用。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

valley.sentenceEn: What do we learn about Silicon Valley from the passage?
valley.translationZh: 从文章中我们对硅谷有什么了解？

viewing.sentenceEn: What do the researchers say about their finding concerning the link between TV viewing and Alzheimer's disease?
viewing.translationZh: 研究人员对于看电视与阿尔茨海默病之间联系的发现有何说法？

viewing.sentenceEn: Balance television viewing with other contrasting activities.
viewing.translationZh: 平衡看电视与其他不同类型的活动

villager.sentenceEn: While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.
villager.translationZh: 虽然狮子并非中国本土动物，但在一些版本的故事中，村民们会制作出狮子形状的神兽来驱赶年兽。

villager.sentenceEn: The villagers finally banded together and scared the beast away with firecrackers(爆竹) and drums.
villager.translationZh: 村民们最终团结起来，用爆竹和锣鼓声吓跑了这头怪兽。

villager.sentenceEn: "He's a very relaxed cat, happy for customers and villagers young and old to come in and say hello."
villager.translationZh: 他是一只非常悠闲的猫咪，无论老少顾客还是村民进来和他打招呼，他都非常乐意。
villager.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

villager.sentenceEn: What did the policeman John Forster say about the villagers ?
villager.translationZh: 警察约翰·福斯特对村民们有何评价？

villager.sentenceEn: He likes to stay in villagers' houses.
villager.translationZh: 它喜欢待在村民的家里。

volume.sentenceEn: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast-fashion manufacturers pump out low-quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times and then discarded.
volume.translationZh: 在缺乏环境和经济上均可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产低质量服装，这些服装往往只穿几次就被丢弃。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

volume.sentenceEn: "Under reasonable conditions today, you might get 1,800 cars per lane per hour throughput (the volume of traffic passing through)," he added.
volume.translationZh: 他补充道：“在如今的合理条件下，每小时每条车道的通行量（即通过的交通流量）可能达到1800辆。”

volume.sentenceEn: Just as height usually declines over the years, so does brain volume : Humans lose about 4 percent every decade starting in their 40s.
volume.translationZh: 正如身高通常会随着年龄增长而降低一样，大脑体积也是如此：人类从40多岁开始，每十年大约会失去4%的大脑体积。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

volume.sentenceEn: That's an annual rise in volume of 8.5%.
People ate around 73 million tonnes of farmed fish—just more than half of the volume of fish that humans consumed—in 2014.
volume.translationZh: 2014年，人们食用了约7300万吨养殖鱼类——略超过人类鱼类消费总量的一半。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

volunteering.sentenceEn: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
volunteering.translationZh: 一项调查显示，尽管有报道称许多美国人认为志愿服务很有价值，但只有26%的美国人参与了志愿服务。
volunteering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

volunteering.sentenceEn: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
volunteering.translationZh: 在一项调查中，89%的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的幸福感至关重要。
volunteering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

volunteering.sentenceEn: But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved.
volunteering.translationZh: 但要让志愿服务真正惠及员工和工作场所，就需要整个组织的参与。
volunteering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

volunteering.sentenceEn: Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers, but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job.
volunteering.translationZh: 大多数人将时间和工作安排冲突视为主要障碍，但如果公司将员工志愿服务纳入工作范畴，实际上对员工和雇主都会有益。
volunteering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

volunteering.sentenceEn: Volunteering can drop after the holiday season, and by February, some organizations lack the volunteers they had in surplus just a month ago.
volunteering.translationZh: 假期过后，志愿服务参与度会下降，到了二月，一些组织的志愿者人数已从一个月前的过剩状态变得短缺。
volunteering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

volunteering.sentenceEn: What did 75% of employees say about volunteering in a survey?
volunteering.translationZh: 在一项调查中，75%的员工对志愿服务有何评价？
